text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth's Senior year has finally 
arrived—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had come for the New Year's shrine visit 
to accompany Sounds of Earth and her 
friends.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, yeah. The lively sounds of a 
bustling crowd have a nice charm to them, 
don't they?

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, it really feels like New Year's. Well 
then, let's go make our shrine visit—"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—It really is sad to see Gentildonna step 
away from the front lines. She was just so 
cool, you know?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Right? ...But hey, I'm sure Gold Ship 
will still liven things up for us!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
I knew the dirt races were where the hype 
was at this year. Copano Rickey and Hokko 
Tarumae have been going head-to-head since 
last year, and it's so hype~!

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief. Even after the new year 
started, all anyone talks about is other 
generations.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Last year, Sounds of Earth and his 
generation put on spectacular battles 
throughout the Classic races. Yet, on the 
other hand—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Gentildonna, the queen of countless 
triumphs, stepped down from the front 
lines, the entire racing world lamented 
the departure of such a legend.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having inspired so many dreams alongside 
Orfevre, the fact remained that her 
retirement was still a hot topic among 
racing fans.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
“—Come now, what we must do remains 
unchanged. We will resolutely demonstrate 
our running and deliver magnificent races 
in the Senior Class as well!!”

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
Just as Earth-kun said! This year has only 
just begun. And we, too, have only just 
begun!

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
...Well, that's true too. No good 
overthinking things, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And so! Why don't we kick off our very 
first session of the year in style?! All 
to make our hearts beat as one!!
choice_data_list: (Alright, time to bring out the maracas!!)

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
Heh, anticipating just such an occasion— I 
brought them along! My maracas!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Braviiissimo!!!! My friend, you never 
cease to amaze me...!

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
Wait...!? I told you, I don't have 
anything like that...!
choice_data_list:
Here you go! (Quickly thrusts maracas into 
your hands)

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text: Ah, h-hello...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: All right! Then let's move right away!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, changing venues, they held a 
session praying for a breakthrough year 
and had a great time...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, once we made it back to the 
academy—

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
Um, hey. I thought I should let everyone 
know.

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
"...Listen. I've decided to make the Dubai 
International G1 my goal for this year."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...!! Magnificent!!!

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that wonderful! So the one running 
is indeed thatâ

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. ...The race Gentildonna won last 
year."

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
Another girl from my generation is running 
too, but... well, we're definitely gonna 
be compared to each other.

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text: ...But... even so—

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to do this. I'll win, and show 
everyone what my running is made of...!

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
"...This is a declaration of that. A 
statement of my resolve, you could say."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I received it loud and clear...! Your 
powerful resolve...!

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text: I can't afford to lose either...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...It is thrilling to see the music played 
by a friend advance to the next movement. 
And—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"I must follow suit! Courage surges up 
alongside the sound...!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
This won't do...! This won't do at all, 
Trainer! These overflowing emotions will 
drive me crazy!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Won't you give me some ideas...! Some way 
to put all this energy to good use...!!"
choice_data_list: Maybe try a new instrument or something.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Won't you give me some ideas...! Some way 
to put all this energy to good use...!!"
choice_data_list: Maybe try a new instrument or something.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
What did you say!? Converting it into an 
appetite...!? I never thought of that...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
However――――molto bene! It certainly is 
almost mealtime anyway!
choice_data_list:
Since we have this chance, let's eat 
something delicious!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
In that case, Direttore. There's a place 
I'd like to visit. Would you care to 
accompany me?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
In that case, Direttrice. There's a place 
I'd like to visit. Would you care to 
accompany me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Led by Sounds of Earth, we arrived at a 
deserted back alley.
choice_data_list:
Is there really a shop in a place like 
this...?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah, there is. A little while ago, 
Universe-san and Flash-san taught me—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: The "Ultimate Natto Shop" is here!!

text_block_list.name: Ultimate Natto Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
—Well, well. Yet another young lady drawn 
in by the sticky tenacity of natto.
choice_data_list: (!? When did she get right behind Earth!?)

text_block_list.name: Ultimate Natto Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Looking for our natto? Tracen Academy 
young lady.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...! You're the one from the rumors...! 
Would you please part with the ultimate 
natto for us?!

text_block_list.name: Ultimate Natto Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Sti~cky-sticky-sticky! It won't come for 
free, y'know. ...You've heard from your 
friend, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Talk about our love for natto, 
right!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I shall speak through music! Of this deep, 
inner love for natto!!!
choice_data_list:
I don't really get it, but go for it, 
Earth...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me!! Here we go!!

text_block_list.name: Ultimate Natto Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
“—Wh-What a... What a performance...! Your 
love for natto still clings to my whole 
body, sticky and all...!”

text_block_list.name: Ultimate Natto Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Here, take it...! Make sure you share and 
eat it together!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Benissssimo!! We did it, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's dig in right away! 
Trainer, got your chopsticks ready?!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Then, let's stir it 424 times!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of us happily mixed the 
ultimate natto that Sounds of Earth had 
acquired, thoroughly relishing its flavor—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
That's it!! Moving your body to the music! 
Simple is best!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, let's change 
locations! If we're going to dance, it has 
to be—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: The stage!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Now, it's time for music!
choice_data_list:
(W-Wow, the sense of speed is 
incredible...!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Come on, dance! Surrender your 
body to the sound!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having suggested it myself, I couldn't 
back out now. Casting all dignity aside, I 
threw myself into moving my body as hard 
as I could, when—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, I was wondering what that 
booming racket was so early in the year, 
but it's just Earth.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
You look like you're having so much fun 
dancing. Are you practicing for something?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth's friends heard the 
commotion and showed up...! I have to 
admit, I felt just a tiny bit embarrassed—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Nature-san and Ikuno-san! Would you 
like to join me if you're free!! Let us 
vent our surplus vitality together!!" || 
"Ooh, Nature-san and Ikuno-san! Would you 
like to join me?! Let us vent our surplus 
vitality together!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, if you invite them like that—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Sounds good. Please let me join in too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
See?! Told ya Ikuno'd totally get into the 
groove~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Wouldn't this be quite fitting? We did 
just eat a lot of mochi earlier, after 
all. Consider it post-meal exercise."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And you sure know how to sweet-talk 
someone into joining...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's still not nearly enough to 
burn off the calories we just ate.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Gaaah! Don't egg me onnn!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Direttore! The excitement is building! Let 
us elevate our spirits even further!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Direttrice! The excitement is building! 
Let us elevate our spirits even further!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, after continuing to dance with 
Sounds of Earth, though I could feel 
muscle soreness coming on, my mind felt 
strangely refreshed—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...! I see! Challenging yourself with a 
new instrument, huh!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, discovering new sounds is 
essential to enriching our musicality...!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now that that's decided, time to 
investigate! Let's go, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, to a place where new sounds 
await!!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Old Man
text_block_list.text:
—Ho ho ho. So that's why you went out of 
your way to visit. Quite the curious soul, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pulled along by Sounds of Earth, I was 
brought to a magical place so surreal it 
made me question if we were really still 
in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"I have long heard the rumors. That here 
lies a miraculous instrument that plays 
the most bizarre sounds...!"

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Old Man
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, those eyes hold an extraordinary 
passion...!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Old Man
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. If it's you, I'm sure you 
can play it. That—

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Old Man
text_block_list.text: A cup of Klopotorte gi Rojankaka, please.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! So that's the real Kpottorte gi 
Rogiancaca!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Please teach me right away! First, how do 
you make a sound with it?!"

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Old Man
text_block_list.text:
First, like this, you make a circle with 
your index finger and thumb, you see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Sounds of Earth learned how to 
play the Kupottorte gi Rojankaka with 
terrifying speed—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Savoring that utterly bizarre and 
mysterious melody to the fullest, she 
gained a new musical perspective.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Haahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text: —Ooooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
—*Pant, pant, pant*... You're pretty fired 
up, aren't you...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Naturally...! Now that I've reached the 
Senior Class, I must advance to the next 
movement as well...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I have to be even hungrier in honing my 
running...! Otherwise, I'll never reach 
greater heights...!

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
That side of you really never fails to 
fire me up...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —...? Is someone running—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahh!!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: That's—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(Win Variation-san...! A horse girl of the 
generation before us, whose running echoes 
with earnest devotion...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...This level isn't good enough.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm not... nearly there yet... To become 
the main character, I'm still nowhere 
close...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: More... more...!!

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! I can practically feel their sheer 
spirit from here...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. The air is thick with tension.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(If I recall, she's running in the Nikkei 
Sho as well. In that case—)

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text: Ah— Hey, Earth...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Buonasera, Shion-san.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: It's a calm night, well worth training in.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I hear you're running in the Nikkei Sho. 
As a matter of fact, so am I.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I can run with you. I'm 
already looking forward to creating a 
magnificent race with you...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...'Glad we got to run together', huh—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Mind if I ask ya one thing?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Do you not plan on... becoming the main 
star in races?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...The protagonist, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—To be completely blunt, I'd say not 
really.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but don't misunderstand. I run in 
pursuit of the glory of victory as well. 
It's just—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
To me, every single runner in the race is 
equally indispensable!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, let me rephrase it as my 
answer! "Everyone was a protagonist from 
the very beginning"...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ngh...—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry to say, but... I really don't 
think you and I are gonna see eye-to-eye 
on that—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"What I'm aiming for... is to win, to 
stand above the rest, and finally earn my 
place in the spotlight."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...That's why, I—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: —All that's left is to go for the win.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Even at the Nikkei Sho, nothing changes... 
I'm gonna seize the leading role...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ah— Now that's how it should be...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ......Thanks for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I'll take my leave now, then—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ah, see you later, then.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Miss Shion...--

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
—Good grief, you startled me, speaking up 
out of nowhere like that!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me. I just couldn't resist 
checking out Shion-san's music for myself.

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
...That sounds just like you. Still, your 
spirit was incredible from start to 
finish.

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
So this is... the overwhelming presence of 
an Umamusume who ran at the very forefront 
of the racing world alongside that 
Orfevre—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Oh, did you get scared?

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
"No way! If anything, it's fired me 
up...!!"

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
Good luck in the Nikkei Sho, Earth. I'll 
be tackling the older generation of 
Umamusume head-on myself!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Benissssimo!! Let us show the world what 
our generation can do together!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, Sounds of Earth's Senior year 
swung into action...!
